AcceptHandshake.name: AcceptHandshake
AcceptHandshake.description: This API is used to accept an invitation to join an organization. After you accept an invitation, the invitation information continues to appear in the results of relevant APIs for 30 days.

AttachDryRunPolicy.name: AttachDryRunPolicy
AttachDryRunPolicy.summary: Attaching a Dry-Run Policy to an Entity
AttachDryRunPolicy.description: This API is used to attach a dry-run policy to the root, an OU, or an individual account. It can be called only from the organization's management account.

AttachPolicy.name: AttachPolicy
AttachPolicy.summary: Attaching a Policy to an Entity
AttachPolicy.description: This API is used to attach a policy to a root, OU, or individual account. It can be called only from the organization's management account.

CancelHandshake.name: CancelHandshake
CancelHandshake.description: This API is used to cancel an invitation. This sets the invitation state to Canceled. This API can be called only from the account that initiated the invitation. After you cancel an invitation, the invitation information continues to appear in the results of relevant APIs for 30 days.

CloseAccount.name: CloseAccount
CloseAccount.description: This API is used to close an account.

CreateAccount.name: CreateAccount
CreateAccount.description: This API is used to create an account. The generated account automatically becomes a member account of the organization holding the account that calls this API. This API can be called only from the organization's management account. The Organizations service creates the required service-linked agency and account-acces…

CreateDryRunPolicy.name: CreateDryRunPolicy
CreateDryRunPolicy.description: This API is used to create a dry-run policy of a specified type. It can be called only from the organization's management account

CreateOrganization.name: CreateOrganization
CreateOrganization.description: This API is used to create an organization. The account whose user is calling this API automatically becomes the management account of the new organization. This API must be called using the credentials from the account that is to become the new organization's management account.

CreateOrganizationalUnit.name: CreateOrganizationalUnit
CreateOrganizationalUnit.description: This API is used to create an OU in a root or a parent OU. An OU is a container of accounts. It enables you to group your accounts to apply policies based on your business requirements. This API can be called only from the organization's management account.

CreatePolicy.name: CreatePolicy
CreatePolicy.description: This API is used to create a policy of the specified type. It can be called only from the organization's management account.

CreateResourceAccount.name: CreateResourceAccount
CreateResourceAccount.description: This API is used to create an account. The generated account automatically becomes a member account of the organization holding the account that calls this API. This API can be called only from the organization's management account. The Organizations service creates the required service-linked agency and account-acces…

CreateTagResource.name: CreateTagResource
CreateTagResource.summary: Adding Tags to the Specified Resource
CreateTagResource.description: This API is used to add one or more tags to the specified resource. You can attach tags to any of the following organization resources: accounts, OUs, roots, and policies. This API can be called only from the organization's management account.

DeclineHandshake.name: DeclineHandshake
DeclineHandshake.description: This API is used to decline an invitation to join an organization. This sets the invitation state to Declined and deactivates the invitation. This API can be called only from the account that received the invitation. The invitation initiator cannot re-activate a declined invitation but can re-initiate a new invitation.

DeleteDryRunPolicy.name: DeleteDryRunPolicy
DeleteDryRunPolicy.description: This API is used to delete a specified dry-run policy from an organization. Before calling this API, you must detach the policy from all OUs, roots, and accounts. It can be called only from the organization's management account.

DeleteOrganization.name: DeleteOrganization
DeleteOrganization.description: This API is used to delete an organization. You must use the management account call this API. The organization must be empty of accounts, organizational units (OUs), and policies.

DeleteOrganizationalUnit.name: DeleteOrganizationalUnit
DeleteOrganizationalUnit.description: This API is used to delete an OU from the root or another OU. Before deleting an OU, you must remove all member accounts from the OU or move them to another OU, and also remove the child OUs from the OU. This API can be called only from the organization's management account.

DeletePolicy.name: DeletePolicy
DeletePolicy.description: This API is used to delete the specified account from an organization. Before calling this API, you must detach the policy from all OUs, roots, and accounts. This API can be called only from the organization's management account.

DeleteTagResource.name: DeleteTagResource
DeleteTagResource.summary: Deleting Tags with the Specified Key from the Specified Resource
DeleteTagResource.description: This API is used to delete any tags with the specified key from the specified resource. You can attach tags to any of the following organization resources: accounts, OUs, roots, and policies. This API can be called only from the organization's management account.

DeregisterDelegatedAdministrator.name: DeregisterDelegatedAdministrator
DeregisterDelegatedAdministrator.description: This API is used to remove the specified member account as the delegated administrator for the specified service. It can be called only from the organization's management account.

DetachDryRunPolicy.name: DetachDryRunPolicy
DetachDryRunPolicy.summary: Detaching a Dry-Run Policy from an Entity
DetachDryRunPolicy.description: This API is used to detach a dry-run policy from a root, an OU, or an account. It can be called only from the organization's management account.

DetachPolicy.name: DetachPolicy
DetachPolicy.summary: Detaching a Policy from an Entity
DetachPolicy.description: This API is used to detach a policy from a root, OU, or account. It can be called only from the organization's management account.

DisablePolicyType.name: DisablePolicyType
DisablePolicyType.summary: Disabling a Policy Type in a Root
DisablePolicyType.description: This API is used to disable a policy type in a root. A policy of a specific type can be attached to entities in a root only if that policy type is enabled in the root. After you call this API, you can no longer attach any policies of the specified type to that root or any OU or account in the root. This is an asynchro…

DisableTrustedService.name: DisableTrustedService
DisableTrustedService.description: This API is used to disable the integration of a cloud service (specified by service_principal) with Organizations. After you disable a trusted service, the service no longer can create a service-linked agency in new accounts in your organization. This means the service no longer can perform operations on your behalf…

EnablePolicyType.name: EnablePolicyType
EnablePolicyType.summary: Enabling a Policy Type for a Root
EnablePolicyType.description: This API is used to enable a policy type for a root of an organization. After you enable a policy type for the root, you can attach the policies of this type to the root, or any OU or account under the root. This is an asynchronous request executed in the background. You can use ListRoots to view the status of the pol…

EnableTrustedService.name: EnableTrustedService
EnableTrustedService.description: This API is used to enable the integration of a cloud service (specified by service_principal) with Organizations. When you enable a trusted service, you allow the trusted service to create a service-linked agency in all accounts in your organization. This allows the trusted service to perform operations on your behal…

InviteAccount.name: InviteAccount
InviteAccount.summary: Inviting an Account to Join an Organization
InviteAccount.description: This API is used to send an invitation to another account. The invited account will join your organization as a member account. This API can be called only from the organization's management account.

LeaveOrganization.name: LeaveOrganization
LeaveOrganization.description: This API is used to leave the current organization. It can be called only from a member account in the organization. You can leave an organization as a member account only if the account is configured with the information required for operating as a standalone account. The account to leave must not be a delegated admi…

ListAccounts.name: ListAccounts
ListAccounts.description: This API is used to list all the accounts in an organization. It can be called only from the organization's management account or from a member account that is a delegated administrator for a cloud service. If a parent OU is specified, this API will return a list of all the accounts contained in the specified parent O…

ListCloseAccountStatuses.name: ListCloseAccountStatuses
ListCloseAccountStatuses.summary: Querying CloseAccount Requests in Specified State
ListCloseAccountStatuses.description: This API is used to query the CloseAccount requests in the specified state for an organization. This API can be called only from the organization's management account or a delegated administrator account.

ListCreateAccountStatuses.name: ListCreateAccountStatuses
ListCreateAccountStatuses.summary: Querying Account Creation Requests in Specified State
ListCreateAccountStatuses.description: This API is used to query the account creation requests in the specified state for an organization. This API can be called only from the organization's management account or a delegated administrator account.

ListDelegatedAdministrators.name: ListDelegatedAdministrators
ListDelegatedAdministrators.description: This API is used to list the accounts that are designated as delegated administrators in an organization. It can be called only from the organization's management account or from a member account that is a delegated administrator for a cloud service.

ListDelegatedServices.name: ListDelegatedServices
ListDelegatedServices.summary: Listing Services Managed by a Delegated Administrator Account
ListDelegatedServices.description: This API is used to list the services for which the specified account is a delegated administrator. It can be called only from the organization's management account or from a member account that is a delegated administrator for a cloud service.

ListDryRunPolicies.name: ListDryRunPolicies
ListDryRunPolicies.description: This API is used to list all dry-run policies of an organization. If a resource ID (such as an OU ID or account ID) is specified, this API will return a list of policies attached to the resource. It can be called only from the organization's management account or from a delegated administrator account of a cloud servi…

ListEntities.name: ListEntities
ListEntities.description: This API is used to list all the entities (roots, OUs, and accounts) in an organization. It can be called only from the organization's management account or from a member account that is a delegated administrator for a cloud service. You can filter entities you want to view by specifying the parent OU ID and child OU…

ListEntitiesForDryRunPolicy.name: ListEntitiesForDryRunPolicy
ListEntitiesForDryRunPolicy.summary: Listing All Entities Associated with the Specified Dry-Run Policy
ListEntitiesForDryRunPolicy.description: This API is used to list all the entities (roots, OUs, and accounts) that the specified dry-run policy is attached to. It can be called only from the organization's management account or from a delegated administrator account of a cloud service.

ListEntitiesForPolicy.name: ListEntitiesForPolicy
ListEntitiesForPolicy.summary: Listing Entities for the Specified Policy
ListEntitiesForPolicy.description: This API is used to list all the entities (roots, OUs, and accounts) that the specified policy is attached to. It can be called only from the organization's management account or from a member account that is a delegated administrator for a cloud service.

ListHandshakes.name: ListHandshakes
ListHandshakes.description: This API is used to list all the invitations sent by an organization. It can be called only from the organization's management account or from a member account that is a delegated administrator for a cloud service.

ListOrganizationalUnits.name: ListOrganizationalUnits
ListOrganizationalUnits.description: This API is used to list all OUs in an organization. If a parent OU is specified, this API will return a list of all the OUs contained in the specified parent OU. This API can be called only from the organization's management account or from a member account that is a delegated administrator for a cloud service.

ListPolicies.name: ListPolicies
ListPolicies.description: This API is used to list all policies in an organization. If a resource ID (such as an OU ID or account ID) is specified, this API will return a list of policies attached to the resource. This API can be called only from the organization's management account or from a member account that is a delegated administrator f…

ListQuotas.name: ListQuotas
ListQuotas.description: This API is used to list Organizations quotas. It can be called only from the management account or a delegated administrator account.

ListReceivedHandshakes.name: ListReceivedHandshakes
ListReceivedHandshakes.description: This API is used to list all the invitations associated with the specified account. It can be called by any account.

ListResourceInstances.name: ListResourceInstances
ListResourceInstances.summary: Querying Resource Instances by Resource Type and Tag
ListResourceInstances.description: This API is used to query the list of resource instances by resource type and tag.

ListResourceTags.name: ListResourceTags
ListResourceTags.description: This API is used to query tags attached to the specified resource.

ListRoots.name: ListRoots
ListRoots.summary: Listing the Roots of an Organization
ListRoots.description: This API is used to list the roots of an organization. It can be called only from the organization's management account or from a member account that is a delegated administrator for a cloud service.

ListServices.name: ListServices
ListServices.summary: Listing Cloud Services Integrable with Organizations
ListServices.description: This API is used to list all cloud services that can be integrated with Organizations. After a service on this list is integrated with Organizations, that service becomes a trusted service for Organizations.

ListTagPolicyServices.name: ListTagPolicyServices
ListTagPolicyServices.summary: Listing Resource Types That Support Enforcement
ListTagPolicyServices.description: This API is used to list the resources types that support enforcement with tag policies.

ListTagResources.name: ListTagResources
ListTagResources.summary: Listing Tags for the Specified Resource
ListTagResources.description: This API is used to list the tags that are attached to the specified resource. You can attach tags to any of the following organization resources: accounts, OUs, roots, and policies. This API can be called only from the organization's management account or a delegated administrator account.

ListTagsForResource.name: ListTagsForResource
ListTagsForResource.summary: Listing Tags for the Specified Resource
ListTagsForResource.description: This API is used to list the tags that are attached to the specified resource. You can attach tags to the following resources in Organizations: accounts, OUs, roots, and policies. This API can be called only from the organization's management account or from a member account that is a delegated administrator for a clo…

ListTrustedServices.name: ListTrustedServices
ListTrustedServices.description: This API returns a list of trusted services that are integrated with Organizations. It can be called only from the organization's management account or from a member account that is a delegated administrator for a cloud service.

MoveAccount.name: MoveAccount
MoveAccount.description: This API is used to move an account from its current source location (root or OU) to the specified destination location (root or OU).

RegisterDelegatedAdministrator.name: RegisterDelegatedAdministrator
RegisterDelegatedAdministrator.description: This API is used to register the specified member account as a delegated administrator to manage the Organizations functions of a specified service. This API grants the delegated administrator the read-only access to Organizations service data. IAM users in the delegated administrator account still need IAM permission…

RemoveAccount.name: RemoveAccount
RemoveAccount.description: This API is used to remove the specified account from an organization. The removed account becomes a standalone account that is not a member account of any organization. This API can be called only from the organization's management account. You can remove an account from an organization only if the account is configu…

ShowAccount.name: ShowAccount
ShowAccount.description: This API is used to get the information about the specified account. It can be called only from the organization's management account or from a member account that is a delegated administrator for a cloud service.

ShowCreateAccountStatus.name: ShowCreateAccountStatus
ShowCreateAccountStatus.description: This API is used to query the status of the asynchronous request to create an account. This API can be called only from the organization's management account or a delegated administrator account.

ShowDryRunConfig.name: ShowDryRunConfig
ShowDryRunConfig.summary: Querying Policy Dry Run Configurations of an Organization
ShowDryRunConfig.description: This API is used to query policy dry run configurations of an organization. It can be called only from the organization's management account or from a delegated administrator account of a cloud service.

ShowDryRunPolicy.name: ShowDryRunPolicy
ShowDryRunPolicy.summary: Querying Information about a Dry-Run Policy
ShowDryRunPolicy.description: This API is used to query information about a dry-run policy. It can be called only from the organization's management account or from a delegated administrator account of a cloud service.

ShowEffectivePolicies.name: ShowEffectivePolicies
ShowEffectivePolicies.description: This API is used to query the effective policy of a specific type for the specified account. This API cannot be used to query the information about service control policies. This API can be called only from the organization's management account or a delegated administrator account.

ShowHandshake.name: ShowHandshake
ShowHandshake.description: This API is used to get the information about existing invitations in an organization. It can be called by all accounts in an organization.

ShowOrganization.name: ShowOrganization
ShowOrganization.description: This API is used to get the information about the organization holding the account. It can be called by all accounts in an organization.

ShowOrganizationalUnit.name: ShowOrganizationalUnit
ShowOrganizationalUnit.description: This API is used to get OU information. It can be called only from the organization's management account or from a member account that is a delegated administrator for a cloud service.

ShowPolicy.name: ShowPolicy
ShowPolicy.description: This API is used to get the information about the specified policy. It can be called only from the organization's management account or from a member account that is a delegated administrator for a cloud service.

ShowResourceInstancesCount.name: ShowResourceInstancesCount
ShowResourceInstancesCount.summary: Querying Number of Resource Instances by Resource Type and Tag
ShowResourceInstancesCount.description: This API is used to query the number of resource instances by resource type and tag.

TagResource.name: TagResource
TagResource.summary: Adding Tags to the Specified Resource
TagResource.description: This API is used to add one or more tags to the specified resource. You can attach tags to the following resources in Organizations: accounts, OUs, roots, and policies. This API can be called only from the organization's management account.

UntagResource.name: UntagResource
UntagResource.summary: Removing Tags from the Specified Resource
UntagResource.description: This API is used to remove any tags with the specified key from the specified resource. You can attach tags to the following resources in Organizations: accounts, OUs, roots, and policies. This API can be called only from the organization's management account.

UpdateAccount.name: UpdateAccount
UpdateAccount.description: This API is used to update an account.

UpdateDryRunConfig.name: UpdateDryRunConfig
UpdateDryRunConfig.summary: Updating Policy Dry Run Configurations of an Organization
UpdateDryRunConfig.description: This API is used to update policy dry run configurations of an organization. It can be called only from the organization's management account.

UpdateDryRunPolicy.name: UpdateDryRunPolicy
UpdateDryRunPolicy.description: This API is used to update the name, description, or content of a dry-run policy. If no parameters are provided, the policy remains unchanged. You cannot change the policy type. It can be called only from the organization's management account.

UpdateOrganizationalUnit.name: UpdateOrganizationalUnit
UpdateOrganizationalUnit.description: This API is used to rename the specified OU. After an OU is renamed, its ID does not change, its child OUs and accounts remain in place, and any attached policies of the OU remain unchanged. This API can be called only from the organization's management account.

UpdatePolicy.name: UpdatePolicy
UpdatePolicy.description: This API is used to update the name, description, or content of a policy. If no parameter is provided, the policy remains unchanged. A policy's type cannot be changed. This API can be called only from the organization's management account.
